name: atelier
description: A project band for Android developers above the prompt (APK and phone versions, git, quotas, cost, model advice, tasks) plus guardrails on shell commands. Unofficial and fan-made.

garde_fou_ok.title: Trust GARDE_FOU_OK=1 (your own guard script)
garde_fou_ok.description: For a separate guard script of yours that reads GARDE_FOU_OK=1. On: a command that sets it skips atelier's secrets check, and after you approve secret files atelier adds it to the command. Off: atelier ignores the flag and never adds it.
